name: wave
description: WAVE fleet secret shapes missed by the built-in pipeline (canary-proven 2026-08-14: Doppler dp.* and AWS AKIA shapes passed through 0.10.0's 6 always-on layers). Positive-proof samples live in the lane's local canary files (see governance/plans/entire-integration/RECEIPTS.md); committed samples are negative-only so even decoy-shaped strings never land in git.

rules.description: Doppler personal/service tokens — our secrets manager; built-in pipeline missed this shape in canary checkpoint b66947bd4947

samples.input: see the doppler docs; dp.pt alone is not a token
short dp.pt.abc123 is below the length floor

rules.description: AWS access key IDs, including docs-example shapes the built-in allowlist skips

samples.input: AKIA is a prefix, not a key
AKIA123 is too short to match

rules.description: Full JWTs (all three segments) — built-in caught the signature segment only; redact whole token

samples.input: prefix eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs alone is not a full JWT

rules.description: Cloudflare API tokens (40-char token charset, non-word boundaries — RE2 has no lookarounds)
Any *_TOKEN / *_KEY / *_SECRET / *_PASSWORD env assignment with a 12+ char value (bounded KV safety net)
